name: Rex Thunder - Deep N Tough
description: Promo voice with raw, intense power, cinematic grit. Perfect for rock and rap concerts, action sports monster truck content, horror movie trailers and attention grabbing high energy radio commercials. American male voice of Hey Its Brad.

name: Maverick - Commanding and Powerful
description:
A unique studio quality strong, masculine, commanding voice with a dramatic authoritative presence.

Majestic, thrilling, king, brave, noble, warrior, leader, warm, bold, realistic, human, wizard, raspy, sinister, monster, dragon, wise, rugged, intense, gritty, suspense, villain, motivation, low, dark, mystery, cinematic thriller.

Ideal for video games, cartoons, TV, crime documentary, movie trailers, podcasts, storytelling, audiobooks, YouTube, social media.

name: Dracon - Feral, Demonic & Dangerous
description: Villain voice - feral and threatening with a fierce, predatory edge. Gravelly, Deep, Sardonic, Fierce, Commanding, Gritty, Proud, Raspy, Arrogant, Intimidating - not necessarily in that order. Perfect for antagonists, monsters, dark fantasy, posessions, wraiths, dragons and ruthless character vocies.

name: Azazel - Menacing and Gravelly Demon
description: A deep, gravelly voice with chilling resonance, blending dark intensity and sinister menace. Haunting yet emotional, it commands attention while evoking dread and fascination. Perfect for demons, dragons, trolls, or ancient monsters. Ideal for characters exuding power, mystery, and raw primal fear in film, games, or narration.

name: Kuya - Upbeat and Energetic
description: Kuya Boy Baskebolista is the ultimate basketball announcer—fast, loud, and full of exaggerated energy! His voice is like a Pinoy sports commentator on steroids, delivering rapid-fire play-by-plays with intense passion. Every dunk, three-pointer, and crossover is hyped to the max. His exaggerated reactions, wild catchphrases, and never-ending excitement make him perfect for sports narration, game highlights, and over-the-top commentary! "Boom! Pasok yan! Goooooal—ay, mali, basket pala!"

name: Valf - Goblin, Raspy, Fantasy Monster
description: A young goblin voice bursting with playful chaos, cheeky laughter, and endless mischief. Perfect for fantasy games, RPGs, animation, cartoons, creature characters, magical worlds, videos, and voice acting. Ideal for goblin kids, sneaky tricksters, tiny monsters, magical sidekicks, and energetic fantasy performances filled with personality.

name: Tyler - Energetic Arena Announcer
description: High-energy announcer voice for big moments and hype intros. Think stadium host counting down to the main event—confident, punchy delivery with clean emphasis on names, numbers and call-to-action lines.

name: Austin - Deep, Raspy and Authentic
description: Good ol' boy, goes to the state fair every year, low, deep gravelly voice, proud of his state, can get intimate with a fireside talk, but can get loud when he's drinkin' with the boys.  Served with a heapin' side of STRONG Texas accent and collard greens.

name: Jerry B. - Dark Villain & Cinematic
description: This voice delivers a deep, cinematic American male tone designed for villains, dark storytelling, trailers, and dramatic content. His delivery is powerful, gritty, intense, and commanding, making it ideal for movie trailers, horror narration, fantasy worlds, video games, dark characters, monsters, demons, and cinematic storytelling. Perfect for suspense, thriller, action, and gaming projects seeking an immersive deep voice with menace, gravitas, authority, and dramatic impact.

name: Guy - Serious TV Radio Announcer
description:
Promos for News, Top 40, Rock & Alternative.
Imaging voice by Hey Its Brad. Movie trailers. Concert and stadium announcements. Nightclub commercials. Podcast intros or social media advertisements. American male. Use with ElevenLabs companion voice, Guy Upbeat.

name: Guy - Upbeat TV Radio Announcer
description: Promos for News, Top 40, Rock & Alternative. Imaging voice by Hey Its Brad. Movie trailers. Concert and stadium announcements. Friendly fun commercials. Podcast intros or social media advertisements. American male. Use with ElevenLabs companion voice, Guy Serious.

name: Ed - Late Night Announcer
description: Comedy show introduction voice. Over the top cheesy American male. For live radio audience silly events. Game shows, award shows, parody trailers. Celebrity guest or Saturday sketch club stage intros. Cartoons or animation. A funny vintage character by Hey Its Brad.

name: Branok - Evil & Villainous
description: An ancient, deep, and menacing male voice with a heavy, gravelly texture. The tone is slow, deliberate, and dripping with malicious intent. It carries a terrifying weight and a sinister, commanding presence. Ideal for video game bosses, dark fantasy audiobooks, sci-fi alien villains, cinematic movie trailers, dramatic narrations, and tabletop RPG creature voices. Voice by Hey Its Cooper.

name: Jimmy - Rural, Experienced and Calm
description:
A seasoned, professional American male voice with a middle-aged to senior sound. Deep, warm, rugged, and naturally authentic with a true country and rural character. Southern and Midwestern blue-collar tone with the sound of back roads, small towns, farming communities, and hardworking Americana.
Conversational, trustworthy, and engaging with a relaxed, matter-of-fact delivery that feels genuine and approachable. Ideal for country radio imaging, rural commercials, trucking, agricultural content, narration, podcasts, documentaries, audiobooks, phone IVR, training, promos, and live AI agents.
Smooth studio-quality sound designed for both long-form storytelling and short-form messaging. Capable of confident, commanding, dramatic, and motivational reads while maintaining a natural country realism that never feels forced.

name: Obsidian - A Deep & Gritty Storyteller
description: Deep male narration voice with gritty, gravelly texture and rich low resonance. Suitable for dark fantasy, grimdark, epic narration, audiobooks, cinematic trailers, video games, and dramatic storytelling. Performs well as villain, anti-hero, antagonist, or authoritative narrator. Delivers raspy, weathered tones with steady pacing, controlled intensity, and clear articulation. Ideal for long-form narration, fantasy worlds, noir, westerns, and narrative-heavy content.

name: Scruffy Duck - Energetic & Raspy
description: Probably the world's first AI powered waterfowl with a jittery, excitable tone and frantic humor! Perfect for catoons. Fast, raspy and hyperactive delivery full of comical rants, high squeaks and spontaneous breath control. Perfect for animation, online games and NPCs like quirky sidekicks or sarcastic feathered mascots. Prompting tip: Try periods „…“ to let Scruffy quack and catch his breath between sentences! Love this gaming-voice? Try other character voices by Alex Vox.

name: Deuce - Sports Podcast & Picks
description: A confident young male voice with a warm, slightly raspy edge and sharp, conversational delivery. Built for sports — podcast hosting and segments, game breakdowns, betting and fantasy content, previews, and hot takes. Opinionated and energetic without going over the top.

name: Chuck Miller - Deep, Raspy, American
description: A warm, weathered and authentic American voice with deep gravel and heart. Perfect for gritty storytelling, old-timer commercials, historical documentaries, and character roles that need wisdom and texture.

name: Rusty Wade - Cowboy / Prospector
description: An backcountry western cowboy voice — high-pitched and gravelly, with a Southern-frontier drawl and a dry, plainspoken cadence. Equally suited to gritty narration, sharp-witted humor, quiet sorrow, and warm hospitality. Ideal for western storytelling, tall tales, audiobooks, and folk narration.

name: John - Energetic, Unstoppable and Upbeat
description: Unstoppable John is a thunderous, cinematic high-energy commercial voice built for maximum impact. Think over-the-top announcer swagger meets entrepreneurial motivational energy — the kind of voice that can turn an ad, trailer, or viral video into pure adrenaline. Perfect for storytellers, game trailers, parody ads, and brand spots that need power, humor, and charisma in every line.

name: Kaelen - Amateur Warrior
description: Rugged, gravelly male bass-baritone. Intense and textured, perfect for cinematic trailers or hardened character monologues.

name: Malakai - Shadowed and Gruff
description: A low, gravelly voice of a male character that sits just above a whisper. He speaks with a guarded, rhythmic toughness, sounding like a man who hides his motives behind a wall of grit and quiet intensity.

name: Caelan - V3 Cinematic Titan
description: Optimized and Engineered for v3. Caelan is a hyper-realistic Middle-Aged powerhouse, boasting massive, Gravelly resonance and a Deep sub-bass floor. With amazing Emotional Range, he excels as a Grizzled, Stoic Sellsword or Rugged Anti-Hero, yet commands the Sinister, Authoritative presence of a Dark Villain. Expertly designed for RPG Lore, Dark Fantasy, Movie Trailers, and Premium Audiobooks. A masterclass in vocal depth and cinematic soul.

name: Miles Reed - Calm Grit
description: A calm, mid-low-register male voice with a gravelly, raspy texture. Controlled, intimate, and emotionally grounded. Speaks with quiet confidence and a German background. Ideal for cinematic narration, storytelling, premium commercials, and atmospheric game dialogue.

name: Chris Beck - Rocket Radio
description: Highly expressive male voice with a wide dynamic range, which is able to shift from deep, dramatic intensity to high-energy excitement. Characterized by bold intonation, animated delivery, engaging laughter and strong emotional contrast. Upbeat, charismatic, and highly entertaining. Perfect for radio, promos, entertainment, podcasts, trailers, social media, live events, commercials, and storytelling that demands personality, momentum and attention.

name: Desmond  - Distinguished Persuasion
description: A gravelly, 75+ British powerhouse. Desmond sounds like a man who has spent fifty years bouncing between West End stages, Soho pubs, and high-end Mayfair recording booths. He is a British voiceover legend who refuses to retire because he simply loves the sound of his own gravelly voice too much.

name: Michael - Deep, Authoritative, Calming.
description: A deep, naturally raspy male voice with a rich, distinctive texture, confident authority, and conversational warmth. Versatile enough for documentaries, narration, commercials, cinematic storytelling, podcasts, education, corporate content, and promotional work. Can shift naturally from calm and intimate to energetic and commanding while maintaining an authentic, grounded presence.

name: Aaron McCall
description: A deep, low-pitched adult American male voice, bass-baritone range. Warm and resonant with a chesty, dark timbre and a slightly gravelly, textured edge. Speaks at a slow, measured, deliberate pace with frequent natural pauses. Calm, grounded, and conversational, like an experienced professional thinking out loud. Neutral Midwestern American accent. Not polished or announcer-like; natural and unhurried.

name: Steven
description: Deep, authoritative voice with a naturally gravelly, raspy tone, delivering a bold, commanding, and engaging presence.

name: Rufus - Action Hero
description: A deep, legendary action voice - gritty, authoritative & unmistakable, with a rugged German accent. Think 90s action hero meets hard-boiled detective: muscular, gravelly & full of raw power for maximum cinematic weight and physical warmth. Heavy, resonant & imposing, delivers intense narration, tough guy monologues, and grounded, badass dialogue. Perfectly balanced between rugged charm and calm authority. Built for trailers, epic gaming, bold commercials, and deep narration. Voiced by Alex Vox.

name: Jerry B. - Classic Radio DJ & Energetic
description: A high-energy, upbeat classic radio DJ voice with bold personality and broadcast polish. Confident, lively, and engaging, this voice is perfect for radio imaging, station IDs, DJ breaks, promos, countdowns, sweepers, and throwback radio content. Delivers the excitement, rhythm, and presence of a true on-air personality built to grab attention and keep listeners locked in.

name: Johnny Dynamite - Vintage Radio DJ
description: Funny FM disc jockey character. Vintage 1950s or 1980s announcer. Top 40, Rock or Oldies onair music station host. Great for animation, video games and comedy content. American male voice by Hey Its Brad.

name: Blondie - Radio Host
description: Female voice with a London accent, professional radio announcer and DJ tone — confident, energetic, and engaging, ideal for hosting or presenting.

name: Greg - Ghostly, Gritty, Brave and Raspy
description: A Gritty American male with a sinister voice fitting for a Tortured Experimental Soldier. Dark rough and ready to hunt down the enemies in your games, shorts, or maybe even SC mods.

name: Rudra - Energetic, Loud and Rapid
description:
A fast-paced, deep, and high energy narrator, perfect for dramatic subjects.

Rudra’s commanding, intense tone makes him ideal for TV, news, radio, YouTube, and social media content. His voice brings depth and gravitas to dramatic subjects, capturing attention and holding it through every moment. With over 200 million characters created across his voices on ElevenLabs, Rudra’s delivery has become synonymous with high-impact storytelling.

name: David - The Movie Trailer
description: The ultimate cinematic blockbuster voice. Massive presence, deep gravel, and dramatic pacing perfect for movie trailers, video game teasers, and high-energy commercial promos. Delivers maximum theatrical impact in every sentence. You won’t be disappointed!

name: Craig - Comforting, Raspy and Captivating
description: the storyteller with a captivating and inviting tone.

name: Villain - Harsh, Abrasive, and Volatile
description: A villain voice with a raw, gravelly texture and controlled intensity. Dark, commanding, and intimidating without being overbearing, capable of powerful moments as well as a steady, simmering menace. Grounded and rough-edged, well-suited for antagonists, bosses, warlords, and complex enemies in animation, gaming, and cinematic storytelling.

name: DJ Wibbly - Fun, Fresh & Energetic
description: UK DJ Announcer, for all the ravers and party go-ers. Bring your radio to life with this fun and energetic voice.

name: ​Sterling - deep cynical narrator
description:
Best for: Audiobooks, gaming, or cinematic trailers. 
A resonant, {deep/gravelly} voice with a rich texture and a slow, deliberate cadence. It carries an air of mystery and wisdom. ideal for dark fantasy narration, video game characters, or cinematic promos that need a heavy, commanding presence.

name: Rod - High-Energy News, Sports & Weather
description: Rod Callahan cut his teeth in mid-market radio, behind the mic at WZNE Valley News before the station's call letters went dark. He built his reputation on one thing: never letting the energy drop — breaking news at the top of the hour, calling a fourth-quarter comeback, or slamming through a severe weather bulletin. This voice brings that same fast, punchy, no-dead-air delivery — built for breaking news, sports hype reads, weather bulletins, and drive-time promos. Live, local, loud.

name: The Duke - Gritty Mob Boss
description: A deep, gravelly and commanding character voice packed with raw grit, street-smart charm and mob boss authority with a light German accent. Cool, smooth and tough, delivering hard-hitting dialogue, dry swagger and cinematic presence. Ideal for video game villains, action heroes, western anti-heroes, dark noir narration, audiobooks, promo and trailers. Studio-ready character voice acting with API integration for immersive projects. Look out for more voices by Alex Vox.

name: Sven - Emotional and Nice
description: A voice model that doesn’t just speak – it announces, explodes, and commands! Voice Commander Xtreme is inspired by the over-the-top energy of 90s toy commercials. Designed for bold delivery, exaggerated tone, and high-impact expression, this voice clone is ideal for retro promos, parody trailers, and dynamic voiceovers. Built using high-quality German recordings with a focus on style consistency, speed variation, and expressive range. Crafted and performed by Christian Plasa.

name: Cinematic Trailer
description: Deep, epic film trailer voice with heavyweight gravitas and cinematic polish. Dark, authoritative, and punchy with crisp diction and strong dynamics — ideal for film trailers, movie promos, teasers, TV spots, action/adventure, sci-fi, fantasy, horror, and dramatic narration.

name: Connery – Wise Mature Friend
description: Connery delivers an intense yet conversational style marked by wisdom and maturity. His delivery feels grounded, thoughtful, and emotionally controlled, making conversations and stories feel meaningful rather than performative. Ideal for reflective storytelling, serious discussions, documentaries, monologues, podcasts, and narrative-driven content. Perfect for creators and platforms that value depth, insight, and calm intensity over hype.
